complete_minimum_shell: Exactly the q^2(q^2+1)/2 dual grids H union H^perp / P-component blocks.
spanning_theorem: The complete minimum shell is exactly the column set of F, and Pass5376 proves its span equals C_W^perp.

literature_crosscheck.authors: Jon-Lark Kim, Keith E. Mellinger, Leo Storme
literature_crosscheck.title: Small weight codewords in LDPC codes defined by (dual) classical generalized quadrangles
literature_crosscheck.result: The W(q) LDPC code has minimum distance 2(q+1); its minimum words are the hyperbolic-quadric/regulus dual grids.

boundary: This classifies and spans the minimum shell for the point incidence-dual / footprint image. It does not determine the minimum distance of the distinct footprint-kernel K0 or the q=11 dual weight-20 problem.
